instructions.question: An author is about to write `piece_to_write` and wants an example from their own work to imitate. How close an example is `author_passage`?
instructions.focus: Judge the kind of piece (scene, letter, argument, explanation or post) and the situation or point it covers, not shared names or keywords, and not how well it is written.

criteria: Unrelated: a different kind of piece about something else
Same broad subject, but a different situation, point or kind of piece
Similar: the same kind of piece about a related situation or point
Close: the same kind of piece about nearly the same situation or point
